latest_news.headline: AP confirms 15-point ceasefire plan delivered to Iran via Pakistani intermediaries
latest_news.text: Trump administration offered formal 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran, delivered via Pakistani intermediaries. Pakistan offered to host negotiations. Israeli officials 'surprised' — had been advocating for continued war. Pentagon simultaneously deploying 5,000 more Marines for 'max flexibility.'

latest_news.headline: Trump declares Iran war 'won' as Tehran denies peace talk progress
latest_news.text: Trump says war with Iran is essentially won even as fighting continues and peace plan sits unacknowledged by Tehran. Iran suspects US push for talks is a 'trick to buy time' for military buildup.

latest_news.headline: Israel plans to occupy southern Lebanon from Blue Line to Litani River
latest_news.text: Defense Minister Katz formally announces plans for IDF to take control of southern Lebanon from Israeli border (Blue Line) to Litani River. Suggests troops may remain even after fighting ends — de facto long-term occupation.

latest_news.headline: Iran suspects Trump peace talks push is a trick
latest_news.text: Iranian officials deeply suspicious that US peace overture is designed to manipulate oil markets and buy time for military deployment. White House official says meeting in Pakistan 'possible' but nothing finalized.
